200.description:
When `stream: true`, returns Anthropic SSE events.

Format: `event: <name>\ndata: <json>\n\n` (message_start, content_block_*, message_delta, message_stop).

Response header `anthropic-version: 2023-06-01` is set on stream.

Final `message_delta.usage` includes `input_tokens`, `output_tokens`, and cache token fields when available (parity with non-stream JSON).

Extended thinking: emitted as `content_block` with `type: thinking` in the final `done` phase (not real-time; same as gateway native SSE).

info.title: AI Provider Gateway API
info.description: REST API: chat JSON + streaming SSE. System prompt on server side. Details: `docs/dokumentacja_api.md`.

GatewayKeyAuth.name: X-Gateway-Key
GatewayKeyAuth.description: Client key. Required for POST /chat and POST /chat/stream.

BearerAuth.description: OpenAI-compatible Bearer token Required for /openai/* endpopints.

ApiKeyAuth.name: x-api-key
ApiKeyAuth.description: Anthropic API key. Required for /anthropic/* endpoints.

id.description: Unique identifier for the tool call.

arguments.description: JSON-encoded arguments of the tool call.

role.description: Role of the message. Must be either "user", "assistant" or "tool".

toolCalls.description: Optional when role is "assistant". Tool calls requested by the model.

content.description: Content of the message. Max 3000 characters for "user" and "assistant", 32000 characters for "tool".

type.description: Response format type. "json_object" enables JSON mode (model outputs valid JSON).

jsonSchema.description: JSON schema for structured outputs (when type=json_object).

temperature.description: Override temperature for this request. Allowed only if listed in allowOverrides for modelAlias.

maxOutputTokens.description: Override max output tokens. Allowed only if listed in allowOverrides for modelAlias.

topP.description: Nucleus sampling (0-1). Alternative to temperature for controlling randomness. Lowe values = more focues, higher values = more random.

stop.description: Sequence(s) where generating should stop. Can be a string or array of strings.

frequencyPenalty.description: Penalize new tokens based on their frequency in the text. (-2 to 2).

presencePenalty.description: Penalize new tokens based on their presence in the text. (-2 to 2).

responseFormat.description: Desired response format. Use {type: "json_object") for JSON mode.

topK.description: Top-K sampling (Anthropic/Google only). Only used when provider supports it. Limits sampling to top K tokens.

thinkingEnabled.description: Enable extended thinking/reasoning mode for reasoning-capable models.OpenAI: gpt-5+ models use Responses API reasoning.Anthropic: enables thinking parameter with budget_tokens (min. 1024).Google Gemini: enables ThinkingConfig (Gemini 3.0+ only)Significantly increases latency and token usage (2-10x cost).

thinkingBudget.description: Thinking budget or effort level (provider-specific interpretation). OpenAI: "none" | "minimal" | "low" | "medium" | "high" | "xhigh" | "max" (maps to reasoning.effort). Anthropic: integer token budget (min 1024) OR "low" | "medium" | "high" | "xhigh" | "max" (maps to output_config.effort). Google Gemini: integer thought tokens (thinkingBudget, min 1024) OR "minimal" | "low" | "medium" | "high" (maps to thinkingLevel). Default when omitted: provider-specific (OpenAI=medium, Anthropic=adaptive, Gemini=high).

parallelToolCalls.description: Whether the model may call multiple tools in parallel (OpenAI Responses API).

toolChoice.description: Optional tool choice. If not provided, the model will decide which tool to use.

modelAlias.description: Model alias to use for the request. Must be defined in the configuration.

messages.description: Array of messages to send in the request. Each message must have a role and content. Maximum 150 messages.

params.description: Optional generation overrides. Only fields listed in allowOverrides for this modelAlias are accepted.

conversationId.description: Optional conversation ID to group multiple requests into a single conversation for metrics tracking. Generate unique ID on the client side and reuse it for all requests in the same conversation.

metadata.description: User-defined metadata for tracking and analytics. Propagated to providers when supported (OpenAI, Anthropic).

text.description: Response text generated by the model.

promptCacheHitTokens.description: Prompt cache hit tokens (Anthropic). Number of input tokens read from cache.

promptCacheCreationTokens.description: Promp cache creation tokens (Anthropic). Number of input tokens written to cache.

message.example: Parameter frequencyPenalty is not supported by this provider and was ignored.

field.description: Optional field name that triggered the warning

effectiveModelAlias.description: Only after successful fallback in YAML

conversationId.description: Conversation ID returned to client (echo conversationId from body or conv_<uuid> when missing in request). Sentry grouping requires the same ID in body of subsequent requests — see conversation-tracking.md.

cached.description: Whether the response was returned from cache

usageDetails.description: Extended usage details (cache tokens, reasoning tokens). Populated when provider supports extended usage details.

systemFingerprint.description: System fingerprinting (OpenAI). Identifier for backend configuration snapshot.

thinkingContent.description: Extended thinking/reasoning content from model. Not streamed in real-time.
thinkingContent.example: Let me think about this step by step...

warnings.description: Optional warnings about parameters that were accepted but ignored or modified by the provider.

modelId.description: Vendor model ID used by the runtime adapter

required.description: Whether Redis is required in this deployment (cache redis and/or smart rate limit).

consumers.description: Features that require Redis. Omitted when required=false.

redis.description: Shared redis infrastructure. Probed only when required=true.

cache.description: Response cache feature state. When backend is redis, availability follows checks.redis.

code.description: Internal gateway code mapped by OpenAiExceptionFilter.

content.description: Parts of the message. Must be a string with a maximum length of 3000 characters.

tool_calls.description: Tool calls when role is assistant.

include_usage.description: Include usage in the final stream chunk.

tools.description: OpenAI tools array. Requires capabilities.tools on model alias.

tool_choice.description: Tool choice: "auto" | "none" | "required" | { type: "function"; function: { name: string } }

stop.description: Stop sequences where generation should stop.

presence_penalty.description: Penalize new tokens based on their presence

frequency_penalty.description: Penalize new tokens based on their frequency.

reasoning_effort.description: Reasoning effor for OpenAI reasoning models.Gateway not support this parameter yet.

content.description: null when response contains tool_calls only.

system_fingerprint.description: System fingerprinting (OpenAI). Identifier for backend configuration snapshot.

tools.description: Anthropic tools array. Requires capabilities.tools on model alias.

tool_choice.description: Tool choice per Anthropic API (auto, any, tool, ...).

output_config.description: Output format configuration for structured JSON outputs (Anthropic official API shape). Use format.type="json_schema" with required schema field. Gateway maps this to unified responseFormat internally. Example: { "format": { "type": "json_schema", "schema": {...} } }

thinking.description: Extended thinking configuration (Anthropic unified API).Use thinking.budget_tokens (int, min 1024) for token budget or omit for adaptive thinking mode.Requires Claude Opus 4.6+ or Sonnet 3.7+

cache_creation_input_tokens.description: Prompt cache creation tokens (Anthropic). Number of input tokens written to cache.

cache_read_input_tokens.description: Prompt cache read tokens (Anthropic). Number of input tokens read from cache.

effectiveModelAlias.description: Model alias actually used for provider call (after fallback)
